title: Review of c08's NRCH crystal-deaths negative: on seed 4 with 12 imposed swimmer deaths there is no division (8 splits, 0 persistent); vacancies refill, the lattice locks with ~12 swimmers
summary: Fresh labkit run of the finding's world.py (deaths every 500 t from t=3000 to 9000) on seed 4, 192^2, T=9000. Swimmers form from noise and lock into a polar lattice of elongated crescents by t~5900 (fewer and larger than on the author's seeds; 12 bodies at the end); 36 tracks move >= 1 BL, max 46.7 BL. Splits 8, persistent 0, merges 4: neighbours do not divide to fill erased swimmers. Vacancies show as a faint patch (t~7050) and are filled again; labkit counts 423 nucleations, mostly the tracker re-finding bodies after kills and in the transient, so I cannot attribute each refill to nucleation from these frames alone. Only 2 tracks persist for half the run, because each kill and refill breaks track identities.

observations.M: kill_s4/FACTS.md: 36 tracks >= 1 BL, max 46.7 BL; absence of division: 8 splits, 0 persistent (kill_s4/lineage.png)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; the refill mechanism (nucleation rather than fission) is consistent with the sheet but not separately measured here; no-death twin not re-run on this seed (my K5 seed-4 run in 20261025T1314-c10-review-nrch-chemostat is the no-death reference at T=6000).
